note: Schema macro round 35: a stale-entry check parses the file under the fallback so module chains come from the source braces (proc-macro server); a multipart Vec field with an explicit form_data default = false is no longer required in the request schema; schema(value_type = T) and its generic arguments are re-rooted at the source module for schema_type! DTOs and inline relation types; an undecided cfg-gated field no longer blocks an add of its name (only a decided one does); an adapter whose container cfg_attr sets a schema name or a serde conversion under an undecided predicate is refused with a spanned error; a container cfg_attr serde item is judged only while its predicate is statically active; same_file_override tests moved to a sidecar module.
